deck_title: Strouhal-Karman velocity-coupled vortex flutter vs naive fixed-frequency wind slip rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Vincenc Strouhal (1878) & Theodore von Karman (1911) vortex-shedding frequency scaling law (f_shed = St * U / D with St ≈ 0.20, scaling oscillation frequency linearly with wind velocity U(u) = U_0*(1 + u) so convective wake wavelength lambda = U / f = D / St locks at lambda/lambda_0 = 1.0000x across all 17 wind-acceleration stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 desynced stations) versus naive fixed-frequency vertex flutter (f = f_0 = const, which decouples oscillation rate from wind speed and stretches apparent wake wavelength as 1 + u to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-vortex Karman street Biot-Savart advection.

Aeolian cable hum, underwater kelp sway, and bluff-body wake vortex shedding animations
Coupling phase accumulator dPhi/dt = 2*pi * St * U(t) / D so spatial wave crests convect at the true wind speed without sliding
Closed-form Strouhal scaling across Reynolds numbers 250 < Re < 2e5 (St ≈ 0.20)
not_for: Vacuum environments with zero fluid density where aerodynamic vortex shedding cannot occur
Rigid stone statues unaffected by wind
